payload.title: Laplacian Eigenmaps for Recurrence Matrices (LERM)
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook reproduces figures from a Laplacian Eigenmaps for Recurrence Matrices (LERM) analysis, based on computations performed on CARC machines. It requires pre-existing pickle files containing preprocessed data. The notebook uses various Python libraries to load data, sort it by latitude, and generate visualizations of the LERM analysis. The outputs include figures that display the ensemble median and confidence intervals.
goals: Visualize ensemble median and confidence intervals

section_blurbs.blurb: The section introduces the purpose of the notebook, which is to reproduce figures from a LERM analysis. It highlights the need for pre-existing data files and references the original computational work done on CARC machines.
